privacyPromise.title: Your privacy is our promise
privacyPromise.body: Your child's homework never leaves this device. Photos, answers, and chat stay private. Only you (the parent) can see the learning log.
privacyPromise.badgeText: Your child's data never leaves this device
privacyPromise.bullet1: Photos and homework scans stay private — they never leave this device
privacyPromise.bullet2: Answers, chat, and voice recordings stay on-device — no one else can see them
privacyPromise.bullet3: Only you (the parent) can view the learning log and progress summary
privacyPromise.learnMoreShow: Expand to learn more about privacy
privacyPromise.learnMoreBody: All AI processing happens right on your device using a small but powerful AI model. No cloud servers, no uploads, no data collection. Your child's photos, typed answers, voice recordings, and chat history stay on this device at all times. Even anonymized usage stats are only sent after you explicitly opt in.
privacyPromise.headline: Before we start — a quick promise about privacy
privacyPromise.reassurance: You can review your privacy settings anytime in the Parent area.
privacyPromise.accessibility: Privacy promise: your child's data never leaves this device.
